message.name: CreditorPaymentActivationRequestV12
message.definition: The CreditorPaymentActivationRequest message is sent by the Creditor sending party to the Debtor receiving party, directly or through agents. It is used by a Creditor to request movement of funds from the debtor account to a creditor.

rules.name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
rules.text: Identification must be present or Proxy must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
rules.text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

rules.name: ChequeMaturityDateRule
rules.text: If ChequeMaturityDate is present, then ChequeType must be present and equal to DRFT or ELDR.

rules.name: ReportingCodeAndInformationRule
rules.text: Reporting code or information must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: RemittanceAmountAndTypeGuideline
rules.text: If Type/Code is equal to CREN, DUPA or REMI for RemittanceAmountAndType, RemittanceAmountAndType must not be repeated.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: UltimateCreditorGuideline
rules.text: UltimateCreditor may only be present if different from Creditor.

rules.name: UltimateDebtorGuideline
rules.text: UltimateDebtor may only be present if different from Debtor.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent2Rule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent2 is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent3Rule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent3 is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: InstructionForCreditorAgentRule
rules.text: If InstructionForCreditorAgent/Code contains CHQB (PayCreditorByCheque), then CreditorAccount is not allowed.

rules.name: PaymentTypeInformationRule
rules.text: If PaymentTypeInformation is present, then CreditTransferTransaction/PaymentTypeInformation is not allowed.

rules.name: ChequeInstructionRule
rules.text: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque), then CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction is optional. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Cheque), then CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction is not allowed. Rule rationale: ChequeInstructionDetails may be present if the payment method is Cheque. It must not be present if the payment method is 'Transfer'.

rules.name: CreditorAndOrCreditorAgentRule
rules.text: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque), then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is not allowed. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Cheque) and if CreditTransferTransaction/Creditor is not present, then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is mandatory. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Cheque) and if CreditTransferTransaction/Creditor is present, then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is optional.

rules.name: CreditorAgentRule
rules.text: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque) and if CreditTransferTransaction/ ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is present and is equal to CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent) or RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAgent is mandatory. If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque) and if CreditTransferTransaction/ ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is not present or is not equal to CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent) or RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAgent is not allowed.

rules.name: UltimateDebtorGuideline
rules.text: UltimateDebtor may only be present if different from Debtor.

rules.name: ChequeInstructionDeliverToDebtorGuideline
rules.text: If CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is present and if CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod/Code is CRDB (CourierToDebtor), MLDB (MailToDebtor), PUDB (PickUpByDebtor) or RGDB (RegisteredMailToDebtor), then CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction/DeliverTo may only be present if different than Debtor.

rules.name: ChequeInstructionDeliverToCreditorGuideline
rules.text: If CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is present and is CRCD (CourierToCreditor), MLCD (MailToCreditor), PUCD (PickUpByCreditor) or RGCD (RegisteredMailToCreditor), then CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction/DeliverTo may only be present if different from CreditTransferTransaction/Creditor.

rules.name: ChequeInstructionDeliverToCreditorAgentGuideline
rules.text: If CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is present and is CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent) or RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction/DeliverTo may only be present if different than CreditTransferTransaction/Creditor.

rules.name: ChequeFromGuideline
rules.text: CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction/ChequeFrom may only be present if different from CreditTransferTransaction/UltimateDebtor or Debtor.

rules.name: ChargeBearerRule
rules.text: If ChargeBearer is present, then CreditTransferTransaction/ChargeBearer is not allowed. If CreditTransferTransaction/ChargeBearer is present, then ChargeBearer is not allowed. CreditTransferTransaction/ChargeBearer and ChargeBearer may both be absent.

rules.name: RequestedExecutionDateRule
rules.text: RequestedExecutionDate must be absent or CreditTransferTransaction/RequestedExecutionDate must be absent. Both may be absent.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction. The SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose.
